project: Ganachai Boyz — guild landing page (Ragnarok: The New World)

species.name: Pak Kad Kiew Plee (Thai mustard greens, ผักกาดเขียวปลี)
species.CRITICAL_NOTE: NOT bok choy, NOT napa cabbage, NOT lettuce. Anatomy locked from source photo: LOOSE OPEN head (not tight ball), broad wavy-edged dark-green leaves that flare outward like a popped collar, prominent pale yellow-green midribs radiating up each leaf, thick pale celery-like stems bundled at the base. Outer leaves droop wide, inner leaves stand upright.

anatomyMapping.face: on the pale inner-leaf cluster / upper stem bundle, small glossy chibi face
anatomyMapping.body: stem bundle = torso, thick pale stems read as muscle
anatomyMapping.collar: outer drooping leaves flare like a gangster coat collar
anatomyMapping.tattoos: dark green-black ink ON the pale stems and midribs, visible and readable
anatomyMapping.limbs: stubby leaf-wrapped arms, small root-tip feet

species.artStyle: high-end 3D render, Pixar-quality chibi, glossy subsurface-scattered leaf material, cute but menacing. Ragnarok Online world cues (isometric-friendly proportions, RO architecture in backgrounds). NOT anime 2D, NOT flat illustration.

characters.name: Big Plee

traits.build: largest and widest of the crew, oldest most-pickled look: outer leaves darker olive-green with slight brine-amber edges
traits.face: heavy-lidded squint, thick leaf brow, small confident smirk, tiny scar nick on one outer leaf
traits.tattoo: PRIMARY IDENTIFIER: green-black dragon tattoo coiling up the pale stem torso
traits.gear: Lord Knight pauldron on one shoulder-leaf, massive two-handed sword planted or carried, gold pinky-ring on leaf tip

characters.CRITICAL_NOTE: Dragon tattoo must be visible on PALE stem area or it disappears against dark leaves.

characters.name: Lil' Dong

traits.build: smallest, tightest leaf head, compact and quick
traits.face: sharp narrow eyes, teardrop tattoo under left eye, deadpan
traits.tattoo: PRIMARY IDENTIFIER: teardrop under left eye + stitch-mark tattoo across stem
traits.gear: dual katars on both leaf-arms, dark red assassin sash tied around stem waist, hood formed by one folded-over leaf

characters.CRITICAL_NOTE: Teardrop under LEFT eye. Hood is a folded LEAF, not fabric covering the head.

characters.name: Auntie Kiew

traits.build: tall elegant upright inner leaves like a headdress, graceful
traits.face: serene closed-eye smile that can snap to a terrifying glare, small beauty mark
traits.tattoo: PRIMARY IDENTIFIER: rosary-bead tattoo ringing the stem like a necklace + real gold rosary held in leaf hands
traits.gear: High Priest white-and-gold mantle draped over outer leaves, glowing gold cross buckler, holy glow aura
traits.extras: gold hoop earrings clipped on leaf edges

characters.CRITICAL_NOTE: White/gold priest mantle must NOT cover the leaf silhouette; leaves stay visible.

traits.gear: huge gold Emperium pendant chain, blacksmith hammer over shoulder, cart handle visible behind
